Eastern States

the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:

considering a ban on manufacture and sale/

fall in Arecanut prices in the mandis of
Karnataka and whether Arecanut growers

Adulteration Act, the commodity Arecanut

cigarettes?

KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:

of milk are not getting the proper price of
milk;

being sold at a price higher than milk in our
country;

made by Government in this regard;

station

on a plan to provide State of the art facilities

railway stations;

railway station in Bihar;

completion;

BHANDARY: Will the Minister of

Trauma Centre working in the All India
Institute of Medical Sciences and the
amount incurred thereon;
(b) the number of doctors, officers and
employees getting salary through this
centre;
(c) what are the details of the work being
done by these salaried people alongwith
the locations thereof; and

be made beneficial for the patients by the
AIIMS?

Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,

'Garib Rath' alongwith the cities linked by
the said trains;

ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have gone
through the report released by the Fuller
Institute in New York in which they have
identified six toxic spots marring India's
growth story;

etc. sections in Southern Railway

the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to

Tirunelveli and Tirunelveli-Tiruchendur
sections of the Southern Railway is dragging
on for years;

superfast trains;

made as superfast in each zone during
2005-06 and the number of stoppages
decreased in each case;

increased in each of the new superfast trains;
and
(d) the details of percentage increase in
fare per kilometre on making mail/express
trains as superfast trains?

*258. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH

been appointed to review IR specifications;

(c) the recommendations accepted and
acted upon; and
(d) by when all  the recommendations
would be implemented?

the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:

has been constituted to accelerate the
cleaning of river Yamuna in Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the quantum of funds allocated for

Yamuna?

137 lakh tonnes;

oilseeds production for the Kharif
2006-07;
(c) the reasons for drop in production
of oilseeds; and
(d) the steps taken by the Government
to see that prices do not rise due to fall in
production of oilseeds?
